scope: Reviewed the supported font-program behavior against the local Adobe Type 1 Font Format (chapters 2, 3, 5-8 and 10), TN 5176 CFF (sections 2-19, appendices A-C/F/H), TN 5177 Type 2 (sections 2-4, appendices A-C), and TN 5014 CIDFont (sections 2.3/2.4, 3.2 and 4.1/4.2). The itemized verdicts below distinguish corrected behavior, agreement, unhinted outline policy and incomplete structural validation; this is not full PostScript or font conformance certification. The previous PDF-side review remains ISO 32000-2:2020 sponsored EC3, 9.6.3, 9.6.5.1/2/4, 9.7.4.1/2/3, 9.9.1/2 and Tables 124/125. Only unavailable primary texts remain pending: OpenType/ISO 14496-22 and TrueType Reference Manual (including CFF2), TN 5015 Type 1 supplements including lenIV -1, and TN 5040 PFB packaging. Project budgets are separate from format limits. Reported recovery is checked as ADR 0003 project policy against ISO 9.9.1/Table 124 and PDF cmap selection in 9.6.5.4; unknown charstring escape policy is checked against Type 1 6.3/Appendix 2 and TN 5177 3.3/Appendix A. The sfnt alignment, extent, loca, component-flag and cmap layout details still await the unavailable TrueType/OpenType primary texts; corpus inspection is secondary evidence, not primary-format verification. Static Type 1 RD/ND/NP aliases and bounded procedure definitions have additionally been checked against Type 1 2.4, 7.3 and 10.3. CFF blue-hint ordering recovery is checked against TN 5176 section 15/Table 23 and Type 1 5.3-5.5: each zone pair ascends, while zones themselves need not be globally sorted. FontProgram retained_bytes is an ADR 0012 accounting model, not a format requirement or allocator measurement. DICT recovery was additionally reviewed against TN 5176 section 4/Table 6, section 15/Table 23 and Appendix H; encoding supplement recovery against section 12/Tables 14-15; repeated Type 1 CharStrings names against chapters 6 and 10. First-definition retention and dropping malformed metadata are explicit ADR 0003 choices, not claims that the format standards prescribe those recoveries. Descriptor-flag resolution was reviewed against ISO 32000-2:2020 EC3 9.8.2/Table 121, 9.6.5.1/Table 112, 9.6.5.2, 9.6.5.4 and Annex D.2/Table D.2. The flags are PDF character-set declarations; routing evidence and preservation of Symbolic when ambiguous are documented reader choices under ADR 0003, not complete repertoire validation.

requirements.status: TrueType/OpenType glyf outlines, cmap 0/2/4/6/10/12/13, exact subtable identities, hmtx and post; internal layouts pending primary-text review
requirements.gaps: Other cmap/post formats and collections are unsupported. Format 14 UVS does not change single-code PDF glyph selection and is intentionally not used. Instruction dependencies require TrueType primary review.

verification.rule: Require the six glyf-program tables, keep PDF-selected (3,1) distinct from (3,10) and platform 0, and ignore font vertical tables for PDF metrics.
verification.verdict: corrected: exact Unicode subtable identities were conflated; program-layer constraints now agree with the ISO text and minimized expectations
verification.implementation: Requires glyf/head/hhea/hmtx/loca/maxp; separates (3,1), (3,10), and platform 0; allows cmap-free CID programs; ignores vhea/vmtx.
verification.expectations: Required-table rejection, cmap identity and ignored-vertical-table fixtures derive from these ISO rules; low-level outline/cmap binary interpretations remain pending.
verification.outside: PdfFont::load must enforce cmap presence for simple fonts and absence for CIDFontType2, instruction-dependent auxiliary tables, and table-preservation obligations. PdfFont glyph selection must choose the single (3,0) high-byte range before lookup and use (1,0)/post fallbacks per 9.6.5.4.

verification.external_status: pending primary-text review of TrueType and OpenType
verification.evidence: ISO-derived PDF constraints plus analytic binary fixtures. Secondary read-fonts 0.41.0 comparison agrees on 26 cmap 10/13 code queries. Its mapping API does not implement format 2; no differential claim for format 2 or a primary-format known-answer dataset.
verification.choices: Platform 0 and (3,10) are exposed separately; supplementary Unicode mappings never impersonate PDF (3,1). Format 14 is unused because 9.6.5.4 selects by a single mapped value, while 9.7.4.2 uses explicit CIDs/GIDs. Legacy component offsets use unscaled translation; external semantics pending.

requirements.status: Primary-reviewed CFF1 and Type 2: header, INDEX, DICT domains/defaults, SIDs, encodings, charsets, FDSelect 0/3, CID lookup and all Type 2 operators; CFF2 remains pending OpenType.
requirements.gaps: Known structural-validation gaps: redundant CID Encoding, predefined CID charsets, ROS ordering/metadata and complete FD DICT domains are not all rejected. Nondefault variations, CFF2 Font DICT matrices, synthetic CFF, CFF CharstringType 1 and standalone TN 5014 CIDFont programs are unsupported.

verification.rule: Embed one CFF font, use charset CIDs for CID-keyed CFF and direct GIDs otherwise, and require CFF plus cmap rather than glyf tables for OpenType CFF.
verification.verdict: corrected: OpenType CFF was incorrectly required to contain the glyf branch metrics/header tables; PDF-minimum CFF+cmap fonts now agree with the text
verification.implementation: Rejects multiple CFF fonts, resolves nonidentity charset CIDs, requires cmap for OpenType CFF, and uses charstring advances when optional hmtx/hhea are absent.
verification.expectations: Single-font, nonidentity CID, minimal OpenType and missing-cmap cases agree with ISO; INDEX/DICT/charstring binary encodings and CFF2 are not verified by ISO.
verification.outside: Integrated pagura-text::program checks subtype compatibility and forbidden CFF Length entries. To strengthen CID structural rejection without breaking shared vectors, update tools/fixturegen/text.py callers of cff_font to conforming=True and regenerate its font-binding PDFs/manifests.

verification.external_status: TN 5176/5177 and applicable TN 5014 reviewed; CFF2 pending primary-text review
verification.evidence: Secondary read-fonts 0.41.0 comparison: 668 glyph-name mappings and 1792 code mappings across the seven metadata fixtures agree, with undefined entries normalized against GID 0; the gap at ExpertEncoding code 92 was corrected following that comparison. Analytic fixtures exercise FDSelect 4 and Private DICT blends; no external known-answer dataset or primary-format verification. Secondary skrifa 0.46.2 agrees on bounds and curve counts of six default CFF2 glyphs: static, charstring blend, inherited/overridden Private DICT blends, FDSelect 4 and FD index 256. Font DICT matrix behavior disagreed and is explicitly unsupported; these comparisons are not primary-text verification. Primary review now confirms the 391 standard strings, both full 256-code encodings and both Expert charset orders. verification.choices: Unhinted API retains flex curves, skips hint placement and ignores allowed embedded PostScript. Type 2 random uses a per-glyph 32-bit LCG seeded from folded initialRandomSeed bits, returning (state+1)/2^32; the texts specify seed and range but not the algorithm. Uninitialized transient reads use zero (undefined by TN 5177), invalid index ranges and nonfinite arithmetic fail, zero-element roll is a no-op. CFF2 default-instance interpretation and Font DICT matrix restrictions retain the earlier secondary evidence and pending status.

format_verification.primary_text: Adobe TN 5176, CFF v1.0, 4 December 2003 (local adobe-tn5176-cff.txt)
format_verification.rule: Use the operator domain and arity, default charset/encoding zero, CharstringType two, matrix .001, widths zero; Private is required even when zero length.
format_verification.verdict: corrected: validate entry domains/arity/booleans/SID references and require Private. Hint, naming and printer metadata do not alter unhinted paths; synthetic CFF is explicitly unsupported.
format_verification.implementation: Strict mode requires OtherBlues after BlueValues and FamilyOtherBlues after FamilyBlues. Diagnostic-aware repair mode admits these ordering faults through font.cff-blue-order; reversed individual pairs are also reported, without sorting valid zones or applying hints. Subrs is relative to Private. All Table 9/10/23 operator codes were compared with the dispatch/validation code. Metadata defaults (isFixedPitch 0, ItalicAngle 0, UnderlinePosition -100, UnderlineThickness 50, PaintType 0, FontBBox zeros, StrokeWidth 0; BlueScale .039625, BlueShift 7, BlueFuzz 1, ForceBold false, LanguageGroup 0, ExpansionFactor .06; CIDFontVersion/Revision/Type 0 and CIDCount 8720) have no exposed effect in this unhinted API. initialRandomSeed defaults to zero and seeds the documented generator. Embedded PostScript is ignored as Appendix F permits.
format_verification.expectations: Metadata-only defaults are a reviewed scope boundary, not assertions of PostScript execution or hint validation.

verification.rule: Exactly one of Symbolic and Nonsymbolic is set. Symbolic is the primary reader bit. Type 1 Encoding overrides the built-in name mapping. TrueType selection distinguishes named Latin encodings and symbol/raw cmap routes; missing mappings permit reader-selected alternatives.
verification.verdict: primary-text rule reviewed; reported resolution is explicit project policy, with exact independent glyph, width, text and pixel expectations
verification.implementation: A temporary descriptor dictionary preserves all other flags and all immutable source data. Both/neither is first normalized from Symbolic. Complete Type 1 built-in repertoires establish standard Latin membership by the names in D.2. A TrueType symbol-only cmap without Mac/Unicode routes or a standard Latin post name route establishes raw intent; a Latin Encoding plus Unicode cmap without a symbol cmap establishes the named route. Mixed evidence and Unicode without an Encoding retain Symbolic. Ignored Symbolic Encoding references are not traversed for speculative evidence. Invalid flag pairs are also normalized on CID descendants without changing CMap/CID selection.
verification.expectations: The independent writer supplies explicit code/name/glyph mappings, rectangles, PDF widths and expected Unicode. Strict rejects with the stable tag; Repair verifies selected glyphs, exact pixels, positioning, descriptor identity and unchanged original objects.
